scenes.src: UAE Ministry of Finance, Electronic Invoicing Guidelines, sections 3 and 8.3. Checked 29 Oct 2026. Valorin is an independent advisory firm, not affiliated with the FTA or MoF.
scenes.say: The Ministry of Finance guidelines measure revenue as gross income in the most recent accounting period, from financial statements prepared under UAE law. Fifty million dirhams is the line between phase one and phase two.

items.n: Per entity, tied to the ledger

scenes.say: So the monthly pack should tie revenue to the ledger, entity by entity, reconcile the balance sheet, and show cash and receivables.
We help set up the pack and the close, and check them against year-end.
